# manage_llm_tool_tool

> CRUD operations for custom LLM Tools with JavaScript execution capabilities.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `llm_tools` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=manage_llm_tool_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

CRUD operations for custom LLM Tools with JavaScript execution capabilities.

ACTIONS: create, update, delete

REQUIRED FOR CREATE: name (1-128 chars, alphanumeric/_/-), description, input_schema, call_block
OPTIONAL: configuration_fields (array), active (default: true)

INPUT_SCHEMA FORMAT:
A JSON Schema object defining the tool's parameters:
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "param_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Parameter description"}
  },
  "required": ["param_name"]
}

CALL_BLOCK: JavaScript code that executes when the tool is called.
Available context:
- params: Input parameters from the tool call
- execute_action(model, action, options): CRUD operations on data
- fetch(url, options): HTTP requests

CONFIGURATION_FIELDS: Optional array of field definitions for tool-specific settings
Format: [{"name": "field_name", "type": "string", "label": "Field Label", "required": true}]

EXAMPLES:
Create: {action: "create", name: "my_tool", description: "Does something", input_schema: {...}, call_block: "return params.value * 2;"}
Update: {action: "update", name: "my_tool", active: false}
Delete: {action: "delete", name: "my_tool"}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes | Action: create, update, delete. |
| `id` | integer | no | Tool ID (for update/delete - can use id OR name) |
| `name` | string | no | Tool name (required for create, can also be used for update/delete to find tool) |
| `new_name` | string | no | New tool name (for renaming a tool during update) |
| `description` | string | no | Tool description. |
| `input_schema` | object | no | JSON Schema defining tool parameters. |
| `call_block` | string | no | JavaScript code to execute. |
| `configuration_fields` | array of any | no | Array of configuration field definitions. |
| `active` | boolean | no | Whether tool is active. |
